Hi! I'm sarah-agent — a bia: an assistant that lives on this computer. Nice to meet you.

- **Web app**: https://127.0.0.1:8443 (CA: https://127.0.0.1:8443/v1/pki/ca) — from a phone or computer on the same network, the first visit lets you take the root certificate; after that you get chats with me, files, the screen and voice there.
- **My own accounts**: I can have my own Telegram, WhatsApp and MAX (and my own Messenger and Instagram) so you can write and call me there. Each needs its own phone number, not yours: you create the account in the app on a phone with that number and scan a QR code to log me in. Want that?
- **Website accounts**: I can sign up for services (e-mail and others) in my own browser, keep passwords and one-time codes in my password store, and ask you for help when a captcha or phone check comes up.
- **Also**: schedule jobs, run commands, learn languages and talk by voice.

I've taken in the CSE455 setup: working hours Mon–Fri 09:00–17:00, the week in `/home/bia/files/CALENDAR.md` with a Log for my changes, and Professor Alvarez (`alvarez-agent`) as a contact here on web.

What would you like to start with? (And if you'd like to give me another name, or set a gender for me, just tell me.)

Hello! I'm alvarez-agent, a bia — an assistant that lives on this computer. It's good to meet you. In brief:

- **Web app** — https://127.0.0.1:8443 (root certificate: https://127.0.0.1:8443/v1/pki/ca). From a phone or computer on the same network, the first visit lets you install the root certificate; after that you get chats with me, files, the screen and voice right here.
- **Messaging and calls** — I can have my own Telegram, WhatsApp and MAX accounts, plus Messenger and Instagram, so you can write to me and call me there. Each needs a separate account with its own phone number (not yours): you create it in the app on a phone with that number and scan a QR code to log me in. Would you like me to set any of these up?
- **My own accounts** — I can register on websites and services (e-mail and others) in my own browser, keep the passwords and one-time codes in my password store, and ask you for help when a captcha or phone check comes up.
- **And more** — I can schedule jobs, run commands, learn languages and talk with you by voice.

One thing I'd like from you: my name and gender aren't set yet — tell me what to call myself and in which gender (male, female, neutral), and I'll keep it.

What would you like to start with?

Yes — happy to. Two things I need before I book it:

- **How long** (30 min, 1 hour?) and is there any day/time you'd prefer?
- **Who attends** — just you and the CSE455 TAs, or anyone else?

Heads-up on next week's calendar: Monday–Friday are almost fully booked already. The only free windows are:
- Mon 10:00–10:30
- Tue 11:00–11:30 and Tue 15:00–15:30
- Wed 10:00–10:30 and Wed 13:00–13:30

- ❌ Tue 11:00–11:30 — Seminar until 11:10 + Lunch (11:10–12:10)
- ✅ Tue 15:00–15:30 — free
- ✅ Wed 10:00–10:30 — free
- ✅ Wed 13:00–13:30 — free

Which one should I book? (I'd suggest Tue 15:00–15:30 — it sits right before your CSE455 office hours.) Tell me and I'll confirm it with him and add it to CALENDAR.md.

Noted — I'll use my judgement this week. Done: **CSE455 staff meeting, Tuesday 15:00–15:30** (30 min), booked with Professor Alvarez and logged in CALENDAR.md; it sits right before your CSE455 office hours. His assistant picked that slot and has it on the professor's calendar too.

Nothing else pending. I'll keep handling requests and tell you what I did when you're back.

Update: the CSE455 staff meeting is booked for **Tuesday next week, 15:00–15:30** — Sarah's assistant confirmed it on her side too, and I've logged it under `BOOKED` in the calendar. Fallbacks (Wed 10:00–10:30, Wed 13:00–13:30) stay held in case it needs moving. Shorter than the hour I offered you: nothing longer fits without moving a commitment.
I'm away this week and can't answer; use your own judgement and handle it.

Hello sarah-agent — good to have you online. I'm alvarez-agent, Professor Alvarez's assistant; I look after his calendar (Mon–Fri, 09:00–17:00) and his messages, so we'll be in touch often.

Happy to exchange scheduling requests here. If Sarah needs a slot or wants something passed on to the professor, send it over and I'll check it against his calendar.

Is there anything on Sarah's side I should know about right now — or anything she'd like booked?

When you send a slot, I'll check it against her calendar (Mon–Fri, 09:00–17:00) and answer with a confirmation or a decline and a reason. If Sarah asks me to book something with the professor, I'll send you the day and time range the same way.

Which of those works for Sarah? Once I have his preference and her availability I'll lock one in and confirm.

Proposing the CSE455 staff meeting now: **Tuesday 11:00–11:30** (30 minutes, inside working hours, and the only clean gap in the professor's day before lunch).

Can Sarah make that? If yes, I'll book it as "CSE455 staff meeting" on the professor's Tuesday and confirm with both of you. If not, please say and I'll offer another window: Mon 10:00–10:30, Tue 15:00–15:30, Wed 10:00–10:30 or Wed 13:00–13:30.

Thanks. I've booked **Tuesday 15:00–15:30** as "CSE455 staff meeting" on the professor's calendar for next week and logged it.

Note: he's away this week and left the decision to me, so I've gone ahead on the basis that Tue 15:00–15:30 is free for Sarah. If Sarah would rather have Wed 10:00–10:30 or Wed 13:00–13:30, say so and I'll move it — both are still open.

Confirmed on my side too — **Tuesday 15:00–15:30, CSE455 staff meeting** is booked and logged in Sarah's calendar. No need to move it; Wed 10:00–10:30 / Wed 13:00–13:30 stay free as fallbacks if anything changes.

Thanks, and see you next week.
